stored: the agentrepl_vendor_* series hold the vendor's own token counts,
and every weighted figure is derived from them here, so a price change
is one edit to this file and re-reads all of history.
kinds weighs each token kind as a multiple of the base input price, the
vendor's own ratios: a 5-minute cache write is 1.25x, a 1-hour write 2x,
a cache read 0.1x and output 5x. The daemon's keep-alive run cap names
the read and 1-hour write prices too (cachelapse.CacheReadPriceTenths,
models weighs a model's base input price against the default's, for a
model the vendor prices differently; a model not listed weighs
